cases.name: Chere Alezá Morgan
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Chere loved to hang out with her friends, listen to her music, and take long walks through town. She enjoyed watching “Anime” and other Japanese styled cartoons. As a child, she was a fearless tomboy who loved to climb trees. She lived a gypsy life; gliding wherever the wind blew or setting off in her own direction on a whim. She was a free spirit and fiercely loyal to her family and friends and she defended them, no matter the cost."
